title: One exec to the client: bin/bl without the platform script on the warm path
command_measured: bin/bl run one.bl (file: (println 1)) from /tmp/f1-othman/proj (env.bl {:name "f1proj"}), warm own VM, BL_SDK_REUSE_CURRENT=1, current main SDK /nix/store/2nvkh1n5l7qjwy97qv0syapji2r7kix4-beam-lisp-sdk-selection
harness: research/substrate-ab/floor/f1/: f1-run.sh measures main's bin/bl, then (ns-mount.sh) a user+mount namespace that binds a scratch .bl over $MAIN/.bl (every entry a link to the real one, plus a new-format platform-stat.v1 listing of main's inputs, .bl/platforms/<main fingerprint> and .bl/checkout-platform naming the worktree's own platform) and runs the worktree's bin/bl with HERE=$MAIN/bin, then main's bin/bl again. Binding bin/bl itself over main's is not possible: bin/bl is an engine input, and the VM start then prepares an SDK.
